nomenclature_errata_applied: Public Voie titles do not include Niveau or Palier labels.
Visible labels use Puissance opératoire instead of Magie opérable.
GJS, SP, ME, LI and MV are active public Voies.
MV is normalized as a Voie UCKK, not a secondary public label.
Public program summaries emphasize open knowledge diffusion, not certification.
The institutional recognition caveat is centralized once in metadata.default_public_status_notice.
